summary: 3 film announcements, 2 TV announcements across 5 trades.

film.title: The Inbetweeners Reunion Movie
film.announcement: Netflix is developing a reunion movie with the original lead cast set to return.

film.title: VJ Frames Launch Title

film.announcement: Tiger Shroff to star in Viccky Jain's VJ Frames launch title directed by Remo D'Souza with Abhishek Banerjee and Elvish Yadav also set.

film.title: Barbie Sequel
film.talent: Margot Robbie, Ryan Gosling; Director: Greta Gerwig
film.announcement: Barbie sequel stalled as Warner Bros. attempts to reach deals with director Greta Gerwig, Margot Robbie, and Ryan Gosling.

tv.title: Lioness
tv.announcement: Taylor Sheridan is returning for an on-camera role in Lioness Season 3.

tv.title: New Girl Revival
tv.announcement: Max Greenfield reveals he has seen scripts for a New Girl revival and states that as far as he knows, it's happening.
